name: dsh-restart-button
description: DSH restart button: adds a two-click-confirm 'Restart DSH' button beside the stock Session-log button in the session header. The handler captures THIS process's own listen port, node executable, entry script, cwd and argv, then hands them to a detached launcher so exactly that instance restarts (two instances sharing one Harness home no longer kill each other). Triggered only by the user, never by the model.
author: Ln1m (https://github.com/Ln1m)
